task_specification.objective: Deliver three bounded product repairs: restore authored cemetery spatial integrity, make the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper run and upgrade decisions fully playable and inspectable, and provide isolated dense-profile qualification instrumentation without changing release behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authoritative cemetery package still has transform-space/camera-occluder relationships that hide central landmarks, while the ordinary five-wave/Bellkeeper route and native dense-profile qualification remain insufficiently closure-ready for release convergence.

stop_conditions: Preserve the single authored cemetery package and the bound Warden Lantern, Gravespade, and Wandering Wisps resources.
Do not claim native dense qualification from software-renderer telemetry; retain renderer status separately.
Stop after exactly three bounded task families cover every required gap once and provide direct Tester recapture predicates.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different spatial root-cause strategy—geometry-derived outer-datum rebinding plus selective landmark collision/occluder isolation instead of repeated camera transform tuning—then repair the ordinary authoritative route and upgrade transaction before adding opt-in dense instrumentation.

code: Run focused parser/static checks for the spatial contract, camera, director, run lifecycle, Bellkeeper, upgrade-draft, spawner, and dense-profile files.
Verify the authored map remains a single authoritative instance, preserved weapon resources remain bound, tester actions are release-guarded, and no duplicate terminal transition paths exist.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture shipped gameplay at spawn, critical route, and four cardinal landmark views; replay ordinary movement around the central building/landmark and perimeter, checking collision, boundary, visibility, and no disappearance/occlusion.
Host/Tester execute a normal five-wave run to Bellkeeper activation and terminal Result, then Retry and verify clean actors, timers, audio, pause ownership, and UI state.
Host/Tester open an upgrade draft, inspect silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new deltas and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus, select once, and verify authoritative build state before resuming.
Host/Tester run three serial dense-profile prepare/advance/reset cycles, collect receipts and logs, and record native/software renderer classification independently from sample availability.
visual: Capture ordinary release screenshots showing expanded cemetery scale, external world/external depth, readable central landmarks, escape lanes, and compact HUD without occlusion.
Capture adjacent wave, Bellkeeper boss, Result, Retry, and upgrade-draft frames showing readable state transitions and focused choice hierarchy.
Use dense-profile visuals only as supporting diagnostics; ordinary release presentation remains the visual acceptance surface.

done_when: The authored cemetery has a larger traversable scale and a coherent external world or external depth beyond the playable perimeter.
